body.summary: t3 smoke, like-for-like v2 after review feedback (evidence /tmp/smoke-sweep-comparison2.txt + per-run TAP /tmp/smoke2-{baseline-1,baseline-2,postfix-1,postfix-2}.tap): identical explicit selection (all 439 src/workflow+src/mcp *.test.ts files) both sides, common outer deadline 300s (>120s per-test timeout, >~150s normal completion). BASELINE bare node tsx --test (no --test-timeout): 2/2 rc=124 killed at 300s/301s with NO TAP summary — node emits the summary only after every file child exits, so files never reported. POST-FIX test:sweep command (--test-timeout=120000): 2/2 terminated on their own at 135s/144s with complete TAP summaries (# tests 2714/2720, pass 2629, fail 79, cancelled 3/9); 3 and 9 tests show "test timed out after 120000ms" — stragglers bounded by the per-test timeout and reported as failures. Remaining fails are pre-existing bare-run harness-context refusals, same class as pre-fix. Cancellations distinguished from failures in the per-run TAP.
